title: Chapter 116
text:
"When are we going to start?"

"As long as you are ready, anytime." Tang Shu shrunk his neck and said.

Han Xiao nodded to show that he understood.

In his previous life, a big guild had discovered this prize-pool mission. In order to maximize the benefits, they had publicized the news on the forum and attracted a large number of players. The prize-pool had accumulated to an astronomical figure. In the end, they had really completed the mission.

Han Xiao had beaten them to it. Although he would not accumulate such a terrifying amount of prize-pool, the basic prize-pool reward would definitely belong to him. As the ten antiques had the characteristic of dropping upon death, the difficulty of this mission mainly depended on the competition between the players. However, stealing antiques from the Municipal Museum was not difficult at all.

Han Xiao did not have any competitors, so he decided to set off immediately.

Tang Shu rolled his eyes, rubbed his hands, and smiled. "How are we going to split the reward?"

Han Xiao waved his hand. "I don't need your reward. Let's move quickly. I don't have much time."

Hearing that Han Xiao did not want the reward, Tang Shu immediately heaved a sigh of relief. Then, he realized a problem. If it was not for the money, why would this uninvited guest participate in this mission?

Li Xin's heart skipped a beat. All kinds of domineering CEO plots popped into her mind. She held her hands in front of her chest and looked at Han Xiao with a love-struck expression. "Did you do this for me?"

"You think too much."

...

Han Xiao and Tang Shu spent more than an hour to arrive at the Municipal Museum on the other side of the city.

It was late at night, and the gate of the Municipal Museum was closed. The surrounding streets were deserted. The cameras on the electric poles were doing their job, and the red dots were flashing steadily.

The two of them hid in the alley opposite the Municipal Museum. Tang Shu was holding a topographic map and explaining the plan.

"The Municipal Museum has a total of three floors. The first and second floor are exhibition halls, and the third floor is the staff area. This is the floor plan. Our target is the exhibition area in the north corner of the second floor. I've already checked the area, and the exhibition cabinets are equipped with infrared warning devices and distance alarms. Once we get within one meter of them, the alarm will be triggered. There are permanent guards in the museum, so we can't alarm them. My plan is to sneak in through the skylight on the third floor, and then … Hey, hey, hey, where are you going?"

Before Tang Shu could finish his sentence, Han Xiao had already strode toward the entrance of the Municipal Museum. Before Tang Shu could call him back, he saw Han Xiao swing his leg and kick the door of the Municipal Museum away. With a loud bang, the sound was so loud that it could be heard all over the street.

Tang Shu was scared silly.

F * ck, what happened to the promised infiltration?!

"What are you waiting for? Go in!" Han Xiao turned around and shouted at Tang Shu.

"What are you doing?!" Tang Shu was dumbfounded.

"Your plan is too slow. It's just a museum, and at most a few cars of police officers. Don't waste time playing Assassin's Creed. Berserkers are the truth."

Tang Shu had already seen the residents of the residential buildings opening their windows to look for the source of the sound. In less than three minutes, someone would call the police. Tang Shu had no other choice but to follow behind Han Xiao with a sullen face. He could only hope that Han Xiao was reliable, although the possibility was very low at the moment.

The two jogged all the way to the target on the second floor. Han Xiao smashed the exhibition cabinets with his elbow, took out ten antiques, and stacked them in his arms. Such an arrogant action immediately set off the alarm. The museum's guards were awakened and rushed over.

"Thieves!"

"Hurry up and catch them!"

Han Xiao ran with the antiques in his arms, and Tang Shu hurriedly followed behind.

When they returned to the entrance of the museum, four guards blocked the way.

Han Xiao was carrying the antiques, so he couldn't free his hands. He smirked and turned to Tang Shu. "It's time for you to show off."

Tang Shu pointed at himself in disbelief. "Do I look like I'm capable of fighting? You chose the strategy yourself! "

While he was talking, the guards had already rushed over.

"Don't waste time." Han Xiao kicked Tang Shu's butt and kicked him toward the guards. "Hurry up, you've been strengthened!"

The guards raised their batons and smashed them. Tang Shu was so scared that he hurriedly pulled out a baton for self-defense and fought with the guards. As soon as they started fighting, he was hit by the batons. He was in so much pain that he hurriedly jumped back to Han Xiao's side and cried, "No, I can't beat them."

"Tsk, I'll teach you a mysterious spell to double your combat power. Repeat after me, rua!"

Han Xiao kicked the confused Tang Shu back into the group of guards again.

Tang Shu couldn't win against Han Xiao, so he was furious and could only fight back. He really did smash two guards, but soon, he was hit in the back of the head by a guard. He saw stars and staggered back to Han Xiao's side. There was a hint of crying in his voice. "I really can't do it, bro. I beg you. You have a gun, so you can fight. Can you take care of them?"

"It's useless to beg me." Han Xiao was unmoved. Without saying anything, he kicked Tang Shu back for the third time and said loudly, "I'll support you mentally. If you need, I can give you a strong force to increase your combat power."

Tang Shu, who was at the end of his rope, finally managed to beat the guards to the ground. His face was covered in bruises, and he was panting heavily. Suddenly, he felt a gust of wind blow past him, and he ran out of the door.

"You f * cking wait for me!" Tang Shu angrily followed him.

The two walked through the alley. When they passed by a grocery store, Han Xiao smashed open the door and searched for a few big backpacks. He put all the antiques in them and stuffed a pile of sponges into them. He felt much more comfortable with his hands free.

The siren suddenly rang. Four police officers who happened to be patrolling nearby immediately ran over and blocked the entrance of the alley. When they saw Han Xiao with a backpack, they immediately pointed their guns at him and shouted, "Don't move!"

Tang Shu was at a loss.

Han Xiao suddenly grabbed Tang Shu's throat and hid behind him. He pulled out a gun and pointed it at Tang Shu's head. He shouted at the police, "Put down your guns. I have a hostage!"

Tang Shu was stunned.

How could he do that?

The four police officers had a look of "you're f * cking kidding me" on their faces. They didn't know what to say. A young police officer couldn't help but say, "He's your accomplice. Who are you kidding?"

"Tsk, you failed." Han Xiao curled his lips.

Tang Shu turned his head and shouted at Han Xiao, "Do you really think you can succeed?"

"I'm just trying. There's nothing to lose."

Han Xiao directly threw the backpack into Tang Shu's hands and grabbed his collar. He instantly activated his electromagnetic hover-boots and rushed to the entrance of the alley. The sudden burst of speed shocked the four police officers. They all opened fire, but the bullets were all deflected by Han Xiao's magnetically-controlled armor.

Han Xiao crossed his arms in front of his chest and used his high speed to knock away all the police officers blocking his way. The scene was like a bowling ball hitting a grand slam.

Tang Shu, who was being dragged by Han Xiao, had his mouth wide open. The wind filled his throat, and his upper and lower lips were trembling from the wind.

Han Xiao saw that Tang Shu was in a mess and decisively continued to speed up.

…

This was a bar in Seagull City. The lights were dazzling, and the music was restless. On the dance floor, men and women were swaying their bodies, and their eyes were blurred. The whole place was filled with the atmosphere of extravagance and capitalism.

Volcano and Hunter each had a beautiful woman in their arms. The table was filled with bottles of alcohol.

Both of them were a little drunk. They walked out of the bar with the beautiful women in their arms and prepared to go to the nearest hotel to have sex.

After turning into a small alley, Hunter stepped on a puddle of water. The sound of splashing water was very clear in the quiet alley.

The night wind blew on both of them, and the intoxication that was burning their nerves finally subsided a little.

Even when they were drunk, they still maintained basic vigilance and constantly observed their surroundings. They had long noticed the stalker from Division 13, but they ignored him.

Both of them didn't notice that a pair of eyes opened in the air behind them.
